p02-8bb26b.text: Drag a header to reorder; ghost header follows pointer; insertion pointer shown; order applied to every row including repeated headers.

p02-8c16e6.text: Enter saves (Shift+Enter newline in textarea); Esc cancels; click outside saves; Ctrl/Alt+arrows move editing between cells saving on the way.

p02-9128e7.text: "Edit inline" replaces the SQL display with an editor + FK-checks checkbox (default fetched from `/sql/get-default-fk-check-value`) + Go/Cancel; Go posts `show_query=1` to `/import`. Only one inline editor at a time.

p02-930d5c.text: Simulate query button for UPDATE/DELETE text; modal with per-statement SQL, "Affected rows" count link opening the equivalent SELECT.

p02-9afb97.text: "Check all" toggles every row checkbox; "With selected: Edit / Copy / Delete / Export (SELECT only)".

p02-9f5692.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Query handling, counting and header message
p02-9f5692.text: `LIMIT pos, max_rows` is injected only for SELECT/sub-query statements without their own LIMIT, when the parser found no errors, and `max_rows !== 'all'`; export (`INTO OUTFILE`) and `PROCEDURE ANALYSE` are excluded.

p02-a117d5.text: Print view shows FK cells as `value [->display]`.

p02-a2e7f4.text: Edit opens the multi-row edit form; Copy opens insert forms prefilled; Export exports only the selected rows (`single_table`).

p02-a3dbd4.text: Delete shows a confirmation page listing every `DELETE FROM \`t\` WHERE <clause>;`, with "Enable foreign key checks" checkbox, Yes (danger) / No; Yes executes each delete with `LIMIT 1`, then re-runs the original browse query and shows the executed DELETEs above the grid.

p02-a662d5.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Row actions and selection
p02-a662d5.text: Shift+click on checkboxes selects a range; checked rows get `marked table-active`.

p02-a7b23d.text: Global keyboard shortcuts (D/T prefixes, K console, E export, H home, Backspace back) are inactive while typing.

p02-aa2107.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Result header card tools
p02-aa2107.text: "Explain SQL" only for queries beginning with `SELECT`; "Skip Explain SQL"/"Skip Analyze SQL" when already prefixed (supports `ANALYZE`, `FORMAT=JSON|TREE|TRADITIONAL`).

p02-abcc4f.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Column reorder / resize / visibility
p02-abcc4f.text: "Restore column order" visible only when order differs from natural and more than one column is visible; restoring also persists.

p02-ae4d44.text: Editing a column that is part of the row's WHERE clause rewrites the condition for subsequent edits.

p02-ae7486.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Row actions and selection
p02-ae7486.text: Edit link → `/table/change` with `where_clause`, `where_clause_signature`, `clause_is_unique`, `sql_query` (SELECT list + FROM only when the query is ≥ 200 chars), `default_action=update`; Copy identical with `default_action=insert`.

p02-b10e84.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Query handling, counting and header message
p02-b10e84.text: `fk_checks` request param sets `FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS` ON/OFF for the duration of the request and restores the previous value afterwards.

p02-b14167.text: Button labels obey `TableNavigationLinksMode` (`<<`, `<`, `>`, `>>` icons / text / both).

p02-b19bd5.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Query handling, counting and header message
p02-b19bd5.text: `USE db` changes trigger a navigation reload (`reload`) in the AJAX response.

p02-b29af3.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Query handling, counting and header message
p02-b29af3.text: "Just browsing" single-table queries use `SHOW TABLE STATUS` row estimate when ≥ `MaxExactCount`, else `SELECT COUNT(*)`; other SELECTs use `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (<query minus ORDER BY/LIMIT, SELECT list → 1 unless GROUP BY/DISTINCT/UNION, SQL_NO_CACHE removed>) as cnt`.

p02-b3ba1b.text: Rollback when finished only for DML on transactional tables.

p02-b74767.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Query handling, counting and header message
p02-b74767.text: For each ORDER BY column present in the result, ` [col: FIRST... - LAST...]` is appended using the first and last row of the **current page**, values upper-cased and truncated to `LimitChars`; BLOB/binary/geometry show `[BLOB - size]`.

p02-b790fa.text: Sort links are not shown when fewer than 2 rows (except for views), for SHOW/EXPLAIN/COUNT/maintenance statements, or for multi-table results.

p02-b9d7d4.text: Hex cells validate `^(0x)?[a-f0-9]*$` ("Please enter a valid hexadecimal string…").

p02-ba813c.text: Double-click on a header copies the column name and toasts success/failure.

p02-bda6fe.text: Panel collapsible per `InitialSlidersState` (`closed` default, `open`, `disabled` = always open without toggle).

p02-be287b.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Query handling, counting and header message
p02-be287b.text: MySQL warnings after execution are appended as notice messages below the result.

p02-c390b7.text: Table-qualified `ORDER BY \`t\`.\`c\`` only when the field has a table and is not aliased.

p02-c56862.section: Micro-behaviours checklist › Row actions and selection
p02-c56862.text: Rows without a unique key (and `RowActionLinksWithoutUnique` on) show the notice "…may result in undesired behavior."; system schemas / non-unique results show "…features are not available." with doc link `cfg_RowActionLinksWithoutUnique`.

p02-c6fb7a.text: Sort links carry `session_max_rows` so that "Show all" survives re-sorting.

p02-c75482.text: Columns referenced in the WHERE clause get class `condition` (header and cells) for highlighting.

p02-cf9ddf.text: Headers are sticky (`position-sticky bg-body`); numeric columns right-aligned; hidden columns carry `hide`.

p02-cfee9e.text: EXPLAIN results default to Full texts.

p02-d6ac99.text: The full/partial text toggle image button sits in the action header (left/right per `RowActionLinks`) and flips `pftext`.

p02-dc194e.text: Non-numeric, non-binary text truncated at `LimitChars` + `...` in Partial mode with `data-originallength` and tooltip "Original length N"; Link transformations and binaries are never truncated by this rule.

p02-e392ea.text: Edit cell tooltip: "You can also edit most values by (double-)clicking directly on them." (placement right/left), absent when grid editing is disabled.

p03-7e69f5.text: Column names with comments are dashed-underlined with the comment as tooltip (only when `ShowPropertyComments`).

p03-877a7f.text: TEXT values > 32000 chars show "Because of its length, this column might not be editable."

p04-010770.text: Tab/links only when tracking storage configured.
